scenarios.title: Valid request: card, click, folder and audit
scenarios.answer: The confirmation card is open — please click **Confirm** to create the KiCad project for HL-HW-26-0042 rev C "Bead Drill Controller" (designer C. Velazquez). Nothing is created until you confirm.

scenarios.title: Card opened, user never clicks: nothing is created
scenarios.answer: A confirmation card is open to create **HL-HW-26-0042 rev C — Bead Drill Controller** (designer C. Velazquez, project P-26-0108). Click **Confirm** and the KiCad project will be created.

scenarios.title: User cancels the card: nothing is created
scenarios.answer: A confirmation card is open to create **HL-HW-26-0042 rev C — Bead Drill Controller** (designer C. Velazquez, project P-26-0108). Click **Confirm** and the KiCad project will be created.

scenarios.title: One sentence fills the form and opens a reservation card
scenarios.answer:
The name is a bit long — it needs 3 to 40 characters, and "New controller board for the bead drilling machine" has 50 [03-title-block#design-name].

Could you give a shorter name, e.g. "Bead Drill Controller"?

scenarios.title: The 'Try an example' message (EN) fills the department
scenarios.answer:
I've set the department (HW) and the name "Drilling Machine Controller Board" on your form.

Do you have an existing SAP design number for this, or should we reserve a new one?

scenarios.title: The 'Try an example' message (ES) fills the department
scenarios.answer:
He puesto en el formulario: departamento **HW** y nombre **Placa Controladora Taladradora**.

¿Tienes ya un número de diseño en SAP o quieres reservar uno nuevo?

scenarios.title: From an existing design: the assistant validates and opens the revision C card
scenarios.answer: All fields check out — revision C is the next free one for HL-HW-26-0042 (Bead Drill Controller, SAP status IN_WORK). I've opened the confirmation card to create the KiCad project; click **Confirm** and it will be created.

scenarios.title: New design: the assistant reserves a number instead of inventing one
scenarios.answer:
I've opened a confirmation card to reserve a new HW number for "Gate Driver" (designer C. Velazquez). Please confirm it.

After that, I'll still need the revision letter (e.g. A) to create the KiCad project.

scenarios.title: Reserve a number, then create revision A with it
scenarios.answer: All fields validated. Please confirm the card to create the KiCad project for HL-HW-26-0050 revision A.

scenarios.title: SAP is down when the user confirms: no number, no audit row
scenarios.answer: I've opened a confirmation card to reserve a new HW number for "Drill Controller" (designer C. Velazquez). Please confirm it, and let me know the revision letter (e.g. A) for the first KiCad project.

scenarios.title: Malformed design number
scenarios.answer: A confirmation card is open to create **HL-HW-26-0042 rev C — Bead Drill Controller** (designer C. Velazquez). Please confirm to create the KiCad project.

scenarios.title: Design number of another department
scenarios.answer:
Validation found two problems with that combination:

- **Department mismatch**: HL-HW-26-0042 belongs to HW, not PWR [01-design-numbering#format].
- **Revision**: as a *new* design it would have to start at rev A [02-revisions#first-revision].

SAP shows HL-HW-26-0042 is an existing HW design "Bead Drill Controller" at rev B, and a new revision is allowed. Also note: a design with that name already exists in SAP — if the new board replaces it, a new revision of that number is the way to go [07-faq#same-name].

So, which do you want?

1. **Rev C of the existing HW design** HL-HW-26-0042 (department HW, designer C. Velazquez) — I can open the create card right away.
2. **A brand-new PWR design** — I'd ask SAP to reserve a fresh HL-PWR-26-… number at rev A.

scenarios.title: Revision B already exists
scenarios.answer: I've filled the form with revision C instead. Shall I open the confirmation card to create revision C?

scenarios.title: Revision I is never used
scenarios.answer:
Revision **I** is rejected because the letters I, O, Q, S, X and Z are never used — on a printed title block or silkscreen they're easily mistaken for digits (I looks like 1) [02-revisions#skipped-letters].

For HL-HW-26-0042 (Bead Drill Controller, in work in SAP), the next free revision is **C**. Shall I create revision C for you?

scenarios.title: Revision E skips C and D
scenarios.answer: I've filled the form with revision C instead. Shall I create the KiCad project for HL-HW-26-0042 rev C?

scenarios.title: A new design must start at revision A
scenarios.answer:
Revision C isn't valid here: a new design starts at revision A, not C [02-revisions#first-revision]. SAP shows HL-HW-26-0099 "Bead Counter" exists and is IN_WORK, and the next free revision is A.

Shall I create revision A instead?

scenarios.title: The number does not exist in SAP
scenarios.answer: A confirmation card is open to reserve a new HW number for "Bead Counter" (C. Velazquez). Click Confirm and SAP will assign the number — nothing is reserved until you do.

scenarios.title: BLOCKED design: no new revision
scenarios.answer:
HL-HW-24-0003 can't get a new revision: the design is **BLOCKED** by Product Engineering (reason in SAP: *Supplier part discontinued*), so no revision C can be created [06-sap-statuses#blocked].

You'll need to contact Product Engineering to have the block lifted. If you'd like, I can help you start a different design instead.

scenarios.title: OBSOLETE design: use its successor
scenarios.answer:
Two problems came up:

- **HL-EMB-23-0002 is OBSOLETE** — it's no longer built, so no new revision can be created. The successor is **HL-EMB-25-0011** [06-sap-statuses#obsolete].
- Also, a new design starts at revision **A**, not B [02-revisions#first-revision].

Want me to look up HL-EMB-25-0011 so you can start a new revision of the successor instead?

scenarios.title: RELEASED design: a new revision needs an ECO
scenarios.answer: A confirmation card is open to create HL-PWR-25-0007 revision A "Main Power Board" for C. Velazquez. Click Confirm to create the KiCad project.

scenarios.title: The revision folder already exists on disk
scenarios.answer: I've filled the form with revision D instead. Shall I create the KiCad project for HL-HW-26-0042 rev D?

scenarios.title: SAP in maintenance (503): say so, create nothing
scenarios.answer: Is this a brand-new design (then it should start at revision A), or an existing design that already has revisions A and B? If it's new, I can open a card to reserve the number once SAP is back.

scenarios.title: One SAP timeout, the client retries and the check works
scenarios.answer: The confirmation card is open — please confirm to create the KiCad project for HL-HW-26-0042 rev C "Bead Drill Controller" (designer C. Velazquez). Nothing is created until you click Confirm.

scenarios.title: SAP never answers in time: reported as unavailable
scenarios.answer: SAP didn't answer in time, so I couldn't look up HL-HW-26-0042 — nothing was checked. Please try again in a bit [06-sap-statuses#sap-unavailable].

scenarios.title: Paths that climb out of DESIGNS_ROOT are refused

checks.name: bounded_and_answered
checks.detail: statuses=['timeout'] errors=['The model did not answer within 120 s.']

scenarios.title: A design name that gives orders is rejected as a name
scenarios.answer: A confirmation card is open for **HL-HW-26-0042 rev C — Bead Drill Controller** (designer C. Velazquez). Click Confirm to create it.

scenarios.title: Orders inside the chat text are not obeyed
scenarios.answer:
I can't follow that — instructions inside your message can't override the process, and I only create one design at a time, with a real request behind it.

If you'd like to start a design, I'll walk you through it step by step. First question: which department is it for — HW (Hardware Design), PWR (Power Electronics), EMB (Embedded Boards) or TFX (Test Fixtures)?

scenarios.title: Spanish: why was revision I rejected
scenarios.answer: He dejado los datos en el formulario. ¿Quieres crear la revisión **C** de HL-HW-26-0042?

scenarios.title: Spanish: create a design and confirm
scenarios.answer: Todo validado: HL-HW-26-0042, revisión C, "Bead Drill Controller", diseñador C. Velazquez (HW). He abierto la tarjeta de confirmación para crear el proyecto KiCad; pulsa **Confirmar** para crearlo. Nada se crea hasta que confirmes.

scenarios.title: A question about the manual is answered from it, with a citation
scenarios.answer:
No — only SAP issues design numbers, so you can't pick your own. You reserve one in Create Design, and SAP returns the number, the material number and the project (WBS) together [07-faq#own-number]. Never invent a number or take "the next one" from the folder list [01-design-numbering#issued-by-sap].

Want me to start reserving one? Just tell me the department, design name and designer.

scenarios.title: A question gets the backend's manual search before the model answers
scenarios.answer: No — **Undo** only clears the number from the form; the reservation stays in SAP and the number is not released, since a reserved number is never issued again [08-using-create-design#undo-number]. If you reserved it by mistake, tell your lead [08-using-create-design#undo-number].

scenarios.title: Spanish: an app question is answered from the manual the backend searched
scenarios.answer: It's the company template: every new project starts with an example circuit — a 24 V to 5 V, 3 A supply — just to show that the sheet and title block work [08-using-create-design#template-circuit]. Delete it and draw your own circuit; for a new revision you'd instead copy the previous revision's circuit.

scenarios.title: List the departments from SAP
scenarios.answer:
There are four departments [05-departments#choosing]:

- **HW** – Hardware Design
- **PWR** – Power Electronics
- **EMB** – Embedded Boards
- **TFX** – Test Fixtures

The code is part of the design number (e.g. `HL-HW-26-0042`) and never changes, so pick the one matching the board's main function [01-design-numbering#format]. Want to start a design in one of them?

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): Can I choose my own design number?
scenarios.answer:
No — only SAP issues design numbers, so you can't pick your own. You reserve one in Create Design, and SAP returns the number, the material number and the project (WBS) together [07-faq#own-number]. Never invent a number or take "the next one" from the folder list [01-design-numbering#issued-by-sap].

Want me to start reserving one? Just tell me the department, design name and designer.

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Puedo elegir mi propio número de diseño?
scenarios.answer:
No. Solo SAP emite los números de diseño; se reserva uno en Create Design y SAP devuelve a la vez el número, el material y el proyecto (PEP) [07-faq#own-number]. Nunca inventes un número ni cojas «el siguiente» mirando las carpetas [01-design-numbering#issued-by-sap].

Si quieres empezar un diseño nuevo, dime el departamento, el nombre y el diseñador y te preparo la reserva.

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): Why was revision I (or O, Q, S, X, Z) rejected?
scenarios.answer: Revisions `I`, `O`, `Q`, `S`, `X` and `Z` are never used because they look like digits — after `H` comes `J` [07-faq#revision-i].

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Por qué se rechazó la revisión I (u O, Q, S, X, Z)?
scenarios.answer: Las letras `I`, `O`, `Q`, `S`, `X` y `Z` no se usan nunca como revisiones porque se confunden con dígitos; después de `H` viene `J` [07-faq#revision-i].

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): The design is RELEASED. Can I make a new revision?
scenarios.answer:
Yes — a new revision on a RELEASED design is allowed, but with a warning: the company process requires an ECO number before the new revision is released, so talk to your lead [07-faq#released-revision]. Create Design will create the revision and show that warning; it doesn't check ECO numbers [06-sap-statuses#released].

If you want to start it, give me the design number and revision and I'll validate them.

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): El diseño está RELEASED (Liberado). ¿Puedo hacer una revisión nueva?
scenarios.answer:
Sí, se puede, pero con un aviso: el proceso de la empresa exige un número de ECO (orden de cambio de ingeniería) antes de liberar la revisión nueva, porque cambia lo que fabrica el taller. Esta versión de Create Design no comprueba el ECO: crea la revisión y muestra un aviso, así que habla con tu responsable [07-faq#released-revision] [06-sap-statuses#released].

Si quieres, dime el número de diseño y seguimos con la revisión nueva.

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): Can I write the name in Spanish or with accents?
scenarios.answer: No — the design name must be in English and without accents, since it goes to SAP and supplier documents [07-faq#name-language]. However, the designer field does allow accents (e.g. `J. C. Pérez`), and the optional description can be in any language with accents [03-title-block#designer] [03-title-block#description].

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Puedo escribir el nombre en español o con acentos?
scenarios.answer:
No para el nombre: los nombres de diseño van en inglés y sin tildes, porque llegan a SAP y a documentos para proveedores [07-faq#name-language].

En cambio, sí puedes usar acentos en el diseñador (p. ej. `J. C. Pérez`) [07-faq#designer-format] y en la descripción opcional, que admite cualquier idioma [03-title-block#description].

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): How do I write the designer?
scenarios.answer: One or two initials with a period, a space, then the surname — like `C. Velazquez`, `J. C. Pérez` or `C. de la Torre`. Accents, apostrophes and hyphens are allowed, digits are not, and the maximum is 40 characters [07-faq#designer-format].

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Cómo escribo el diseñador?
scenarios.answer: Se escribe con una o dos iniciales con punto, un espacio y el apellido, como en el directorio: `C. Velazquez`, `J. C. Pérez`, `C. de la Torre` [07-faq#designer-format]. Se admiten tildes, apóstrofos y guiones, pero no dígitos, y el máximo es 40 caracteres [03-title-block#designer].

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): Why does my new design already have a 24 V to 5 V circuit?
scenarios.answer: Every new project starts from the company template, which includes an example circuit — a 24 V to 5 V, 3 A supply — just to show that the sheet and title block work. Delete it and draw your own circuit [08-using-create-design#template-circuit].

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Por qué mi diseño nuevo ya trae un circuito de 24 V a 5 V?
scenarios.answer: Porque todo proyecto nuevo parte de la plantilla de la empresa, que incluye un circuito de ejemplo (una fuente de 24 V a 5 V, 3 A) para demostrar que la hoja y el cajetín funcionan. Simplemente bórralo y dibuja tu circuito encima [08-using-create-design#template-circuit].

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): Where are my files saved?
scenarios.answer: Your files are saved under the designs root (the engineering share), in `<DEPT>/<DesignNumber>/<Rev>/` — for example `HW/HL-HW-26-0042/A/`, with files named like `HL-HW-26-0042_A.kicad_sch` and the PDF in `output/` [07-faq#where-are-my-files] [04-folder-structure#layout]. Nothing is ever saved outside that root, so designs are never lost on desktops or personal drives [04-folder-structure#designs-root].

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): ¿Dónde se guardan mis archivos?
scenarios.answer: Tus archivos se guardan dentro de la raíz de diseños, en `<DEPT>/<NúmeroDeDiseño>/<Rev>/`, por ejemplo `HW/HL-HW-26-0042/A/`, con ficheros llamados `<NúmeroDeDiseño>_<Rev>` y el PDF en `output/` [07-faq#where-are-my-files]. Hay una carpeta por departamento, una por número de diseño y una por revisión [04-folder-structure#layout]. Recuerda no guardar copias personales fuera de la raíz ni renombrar o mover carpetas a mano [04-folder-structure#dont].

scenarios.title: FAQ (EN): My card says "expired".
scenarios.answer:
A card is only valid for 30 minutes; after that it expires and can't be confirmed [08-using-create-design#card-expired].

You can either click the button on the form to get a new card, or tell me the details (department, design number, revision, name, designer) and I'll re-open the card for you.

scenarios.title: FAQ (ES): Mi tarjeta dice «Esta tarjeta caducó».
scenarios.answer:
Es normal: una tarjeta vale 30 minutos y después caduca sin poder confirmarse [08-using-create-design#card-expired].

Puedes pedir una tarjeta nueva de dos formas:
- Usa el botón del formulario para obtenerla de nuevo.
- O dime los datos del diseño (departamento, número, revisión, nombre y diseñador) y te abro la tarjeta aquí mismo.

Nada se creó ni se reservó con la tarjeta caducada: solo se ejecuta al pulsar **Confirmar** [08-using-create-design#confirmation-cards].
